in_marathi.name: Apoorvaa
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे First to appear, novel, new
in_marathi.long_meaning: Apoorvaa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Apoorvaa is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'apoorva', which means 'first to appear' or 'new'. This name is often given to a child who is the firstborn or who brings something new into the family. It is also associated with the idea of being unique and innovative.
